properties.description:
The recursive visual component is delivered as preparation for the MVP plan review. Remaining work is to connect the approved execution/iteration contracts, parent-state semantics and attempt results, then validate the full acceptance cases. Reuse that component rather than creating another graph. 

Evolve the existing owned UI components into a reusable recursive graph; use the same nodes at every depth. Preserve full parent header on expansion and avatars on collapse. Render type plus optional title, outcome/state circle, avatar to its right, and direct-child count before chevron with tooltip. Pack from successors toward prerequisites, align fork/merge origins left, reuse columns only after open dependencies release them. Orthogonal segments with rounded quarter-circle corners connect circle top to successor bottom continuously across nesting; no text overlap, false attachment or duplicate task node. Local Now boundaries follow the agreed state semantics, not a timestamp axis. Critical criteria 7–9, 11, 14.
properties.title: Integrate the approved execution model into Task graph
